evidence.quote: However, we also noted that SOTA models do not yet utilize these advanced features consistently or may misuse them, indicating a gap in capability.

However, we also observe cases (Appendix C.3) where the agent creates sub-agents with mismatched toolsets and purposes, hallucinated tools and sub-agents, or overly complicated instructions, reducing the effectiveness.
First, we plan to extend OpenSage to support AI-generated workflows.
Second, we plan to incorporate model training support on top of OpenSage.
